13.  (1)  A  court  shall  not  initiate  any  proceedings  in
relation to contempt of a court, tribunal or institution, either
on its own motion or otherwise, after the expiry of a period
of  one  year  from  the  date  on  which  such  contempt  was
formally brought to the attention of that court.
(2)  A tribunal or institution shall not refer to the Court of
Appeal any matter relating to the contempt of such tribunal
or institution, after the expiry of a period of one year from
the date on which such contempt was formally brought to
the attention of that tribunal or institution.
